user_intent.original_question: 统计 2000-2023 年每年电影产量，并计算相比上一年的增长率

metrics.name: 电影产量
metrics.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE title_type='movie' GROUP BY start_year

business_rules.name: 电影类型定义
business_rules.condition: title_type = 'movie' 才是电影，titles 表包含9种作品类型

business_rules.name: NULL值处理
business_rules.condition: start_year 可能为 NULL，查询时需 WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL

field_mappings.增长率: (COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY start_year)) / LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY start_year)

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 各类型电影平均评分（含热度指数），统计 2000 年后各类型电影的平均评分和热度
historical_qa_pairs.sql: SELECT g.display_name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS movie_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating, ROUND(AVG(t.num_votes), 0) AS avg_votes, ROUND(SUM(t.num_votes), 0) AS total_votes, ROUND(AVG(t.runtime_minutes), 1) AS avg_runtime FROM titles t JOIN titles_genres tg ON tg.title_id = t.id JOIN genres g ON g.id = tg.genre_id WHERE t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 5000 AND t.start_year >= 2000 AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.id, g.display_name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

knowledge.content: title_type = 'movie' 才是电影（长片），不要用 titles 表代表电影
start_year 可能为 NULL，查询时建议 WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
年增长率 = (当年产量 - 上一年产量) / 上一年产量，可用 LAG 窗口函数获取上一年产量
